description: Read one NET earn claim or election by its id, which is keyless, or list the ones a wallet holds, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make, oldest first. For a claim: recorded, accepted, earned, refused (and why) or withdrawn, with every check and whether it passed, read from the board's own facts each time (who did the work, who accepted the proof, how it settled), never from anyone's say-so. For an election to reuse earned NET: elected, completed, withdrawn or expired. To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. It says plainly that a record moves no NET and that the house pays nothing in it. Free; a read by id is keyless, and a list is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

claimId.description: The claim's id (the claimId it was recorded under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a worker, to list its claims and elections. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

name: net_earn_status
title: Where a NET earn claim stands, read from the board, or every claim one wallet holds (a signed read)
